mon-lunch.title: Crispy chicken Caesar-style wraps
method: Season and pan-fry the chicken until cooked through; rest and slice.
Mix lemon, mustard and mayonnaise; toss with chopped lettuce and Parmesan.
Fill wraps with chicken, salad, tomatoes and dressing.
mon-lunch.flavourNote: Keep the dressing sharp and savoury with plenty of lemon and black pepper.

mon-dinner.title: Cajun chicken with smoky corn, peppers & lime rice

portions.allocation: 2 adult dinner + 1 toddler dinner + 2 adult Tuesday lunches

method: Coat chicken with Cajun seasoning, garlic and oil; sear or roast until deeply coloured and cooked through.
Cook rice; finish with lime zest and juice.
Char peppers, onion and sweetcorn until smoky.
Combine tomato, avocado and lime for salsa. Serve every portion with chicken, rice, vegetables and salsa.
mon-dinner.flavourNote: Aim for smoky, savoury heat balanced by fresh lime and creamy avocado.
mon-dinner.barneyNote: Set Barney's chicken and vegetables aside before adding extra salt or chilli; finely chop as needed.
mon-dinner.storageNote: Pack two complete portions after dinner and refrigerate for Tuesday lunch.

arrangeForLunch.label: Tuesday adult lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Pack two complete portions with chicken, lime rice, smoky vegetables and salsa.

tue-lunch.title: Cajun chicken with smoky corn, peppers & lime rice
tue-lunch.storageNote: Reheat chicken, rice and cooked vegetables thoroughly; keep salsa chilled.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Complete planned portion from previous dinner

tue-dinner.title: Thai-style beef larb with rice & crunchy vegetables

portions.allocation: 2 adult dinner + 1 toddler dinner + 2 adult Wednesday lunches

method: Cook the rice.
Brown beef hard for good colour; add garlic and ginger.
Season with fish sauce, soy, sugar and lime until salty, sharp and lightly sweet.
Serve with lettuce, cucumber, carrot, red onion, spring onion and herbs; allocate all components across dinner and lunch portions.
tue-dinner.flavourNote: The defining flavour should be lime, herbs and savoury fish sauce rather than sweetness.
tue-dinner.barneyNote: Remove Barney's beef before the full fish-sauce seasoning; serve with soft rice and finely cut vegetables.
tue-dinner.storageNote: Pack two complete portions for Wednesday, keeping crunchy vegetables/herbs separate.

arrangeForLunch.label: Wednesday adult lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Pack beef, rice and all vegetable/herb components as two complete meals.

wed-lunch.title: Thai-style beef larb with rice & crunchy vegetables
wed-lunch.storageNote: Keep chilled; reheat beef and rice thoroughly and add cold crunchy vegetables afterwards.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Complete planned portion from previous dinner

wed-dinner.title: Creamy mustard chicken & leek pie with carrots and green beans

portions.allocation: 2 adult dinner + 1 toddler dinner + 2 adult Thursday work lunches

method: Brown chicken, then soften sliced leeks.
Add stock, mustard, crème fraîche, peas and tarragon; simmer to a thick filling.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with pastry, brush with egg and bake until deeply golden.
Roast carrots and steam or sauté green beans. Divide pie and both vegetables across all five allocations.
wed-dinner.flavourNote: Mustard and tarragon should cut through the creamy filling; season assertively without making it salty.
wed-dinner.barneyNote: Keep Barney's filling mildly seasoned and ensure chicken, leeks and beans are cut appropriately.
wed-dinner.storageNote: Refrigerate two complete pie-and-vegetable portions for Thursday lunch.

arrangeForLunch.label: Thursday work lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve two full portions of pie, roasted carrots and green beans.

thu-lunch.title: Creamy mustard chicken & leek pie with carrots and green beans
thu-lunch.storageNote: Reheat pie and vegetables until piping hot.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Complete planned portion from previous dinner

thu-dinner.title: Gochujang beef noodles with pak choi, mushrooms & carrot

portions.allocation: 2 adult dinner + 2 adult Friday work lunches; Barney at nursery

method: Brown beef hard in a wide pan.
Add mushrooms and carrot, then garlic and ginger; stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Mix gochujang, soy, vinegar and honey; toss through beef with cooked noodles and pak choi.
Finish with spring onion, sesame and lime. Divide immediately into four complete portions.
thu-dinner.flavourNote: Keep it savoury, fermented and spicy with enough vinegar and lime to stop the sauce becoming heavy.
thu-dinner.storageNote: Cool two complete portions promptly for Friday lunch; reheat until piping hot.

arrangeForLunch.label: Friday work lunches
arrangeForLunch.instructions: Reserve two complete noodle portions including beef and all vegetables.

fri-lunch.title: Gochujang beef noodles with pak choi, mushrooms & carrot
fri-lunch.storageNote: Reheat thoroughly; loosen with a splash of water if needed.

arrangedFromPreviousMeal.label: Complete planned portion from previous dinner

fri-dinner.title: Crispy fish tacos with charred corn, lime slaw & avocado
method: Coat fish in egg and breadcrumbs; bake or shallow-fry until crisp and cooked.
Char sweetcorn; shred cabbage and dress with lime.
Mix yoghurt with chipotle and lime.
Warm tortillas and assemble with fish, slaw, corn, avocado, tomato, onion and sauce.
fri-dinner.flavourNote: Prioritise lime, smoky chilli and crunchy slaw against the crisp fish.
fri-dinner.barneyNote: Keep Barney's fish lightly seasoned and serve deconstructed with soft tortilla, avocado, tomato and corn.

sat-lunch.title: Fish-finger brioche buns with kimchi sesame-mustard mayo
method: Cook fish fingers until crisp.
Mix mayonnaise with mustard and sesame.
Fill brioche buns with fish fingers, kimchi and sauce.
sat-lunch.flavourNote: Tangy kimchi should cut through the rich brioche and mayonnaise.

sat-dinner.title: Pork souvlaki-style skewers with roast peppers, potatoes, tzatziki & salad
method: Marinate pork with lemon, garlic, oregano and oil; thread onto skewers.
Roast potatoes and peppers until browned; grill or roast pork until cooked and caramelised.
Grate half the cucumber into yoghurt with lemon and garlic for tzatziki.
Make a tomato, remaining cucumber, red onion and leaf salad; serve together.
sat-dinner.flavourNote: Use plenty of oregano, lemon and garlic; get real char on the pork and keep the salad sharply dressed.
sat-dinner.barneyNote: Serve Barney tender pork pieces off the skewer; keep his portion modestly salted.

sun-lunch.title: Roasted squash, feta & walnut couscous salad
method: Roast squash until caramelised.
Prepare couscous and cool slightly.
Toss with leaves, feta and walnuts; dress with lemon, mustard and olive oil.
sun-lunch.flavourNote: Balance sweet squash and salty feta with a sharp lemon-mustard dressing.
sun-lunch.barneyNote: Serve Barney soft squash and couscous with crumbled feta; omit whole walnut pieces.

sun-dinner.title: Slow-cooked Persian-style lamb & aubergine stew with spinach and rice
method: Brown lamb well, then soften onions and garlic with the spices.
Add aubergine and tinned tomatoes with enough water or stock to braise; cook slowly until lamb is tender and sauce rich.
Fold spinach through at the end and adjust with lemon.
Cook rice; finish stew with fresh herbs and serve.
sun-dinner.flavourNote: Build warm spice rather than chilli heat; finish generously with herbs and lemon for freshness.
sun-dinner.barneyNote: Keep Barney's portion low in salt; shred tender lamb and chop aubergine/spinach as needed.
sun-dinner.storageNote: Any genuine surplus may be frozen promptly in a labelled portion.
